scope: Prospective statistical component; selection budgets, complete application arms, judge protocol and actual grouping still require freeze before formal evaluation.
seed_rule: Seed field is logical replicate ID; resolved per-question sampling seeds must match methods within each replicate. Average reference and candidate scores per document/question over those same replicates first; never count seeds as new questions or clusters.
docfinqa_primary_estimand: Question-weighted accuracy difference over every frozen question, including service/parse/generation failure, clustered by conservative inferred company identity component; do not call these verified companies.
qmsum_estimand: Question-weighted calibrated ROUGE differences with both meeting and higher-source sensitivity from results/qmsum_identity/audit.json. Official test35 corresponds to only10 coarse higher-source groups. Independent-group assumptions and ICSI:Bro cross-split overlap are explicit limitations.
mandatory_sensitivities: Equal cluster weighting, a distinct estimand.
DocFinQA fixed rounding rule and shared-label conflict sensitivity.
Source identity ambiguity and higher grouping.
Finite-sample conservative guard for degenerate bootstrap intervals.
decision: 95% lower bound must be strictly above -0.02. Single-seed/development calls never support formal noninferiority. If bootstrap range is zero, take the smaller of bootstrap lower and fixed-weight Hoeffding lower.
hoeffding_derivation: Independent cluster mean differences D_i in [-1,1] and predetermined normalized weights w_i imply Pr(E[sum w_i D_i] < observed-t) <= exp(-t^2/(2 sum_i w_i^2)). Use tail alpha=.025; independence is an assumption, not verified by code.

zero_loss_event_sensitivity.assumption: iid cluster event of any seed-averaged question degradation
zero_loss_event_sensitivity.interpretation: Event probability bound, not question-weighted paired effect. Never substitute it for the primary estimand.

tests: tests/test_paired_statistics.py: seed replication invariance; unequal cluster weighting; analytic two-cluster interval; 59-cluster equality guard; denominator and NaN rejection.
